_README: The ONE place to set business details. Run `python3 tools/build.py` after editing; it rewrites public_html/. Leave a value empty to mark it as not set yet (the build warns you).
_SAME_AS_help: Comma-separated URLs of your own profiles (Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, Facebook, Clutch...). Goes into Organization schema sameAs.
_CHAT_AI_help: "on" sends questions the built-in answers cannot handle to Claude via chat.php. Needs an Anthropic API key in ../private/anthropic-key.txt (outside public_html) or the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY server env var.
